text: I had my molar extracted; it wasn't painful at all. The dentist was very gentle, chatted with me the whole time, making it very relaxing. They gave great advice. I'll be continuing my treatment here for a long time.

Of all the tartar I've had removed, this dentist is the best. Their technique is precise, they don't cut into the gums, it's painless, and the work is meticulous. My teeth are spotlessly clean. I can claim my health insurance (additional 150 baht payment) because I've had tartar buildup for at least 2-3 years.
The clinic is beautiful, the doctor is gentle, and the prices are reasonable.

author_name: MesTrenedii Ch.マスリトリニティー
